artifact.title: Docs format uplift: mishka.tools-style reference docs for the Web Control Plane + CLI (skill, GitHub Pages, package docs)
artifact.objective: Adopt the mishka.tools/chelekom documentation format (per-topic pages with a short brief, live example blocks, visual previews, usage/commands tables, and related links) as the standard for ATL technical docs. Encode that format and its evidence rules in the atl-tech-docs skill (C:/Users/Sanaz/.agents/skills/atl-tech-docs/SKILL.md), then apply it to the GitHub Pages site (docs/*.html) and the package-facing docs (README.md, README.fa.md, USAGE.md, GUIDE.md for @depie99/atl). Scope: the browser surface — named the Web Control Plane (docs/control-room.html, `atl ui` / `atl control-plane`, runtime/control-plane.html), which resolves the 'how do we call it?' question — plus CLI commands only. Terminal TUI enhancements/bug fixes did not happen and the TUI stays a compatibility surface excluded from primary docs until its UX pass. Every documented web interaction and command must map to shipped behavior in runtime/control-plane.html and runtime/atl-manager.mjs before it is published.
constraints: Docs scope is Web Control Plane + CLI commands only; the terminal TUI is documented solely as a compatibility surface and no TUI enhancement or bug-fix claims may appear (matches the existing stance in docs/README.md).
The mishka.tools format is adopted as structure and method (brief, examples, previews, briefs) — no copying of their markup, styling, copy, or assets.
Every documented web interaction must correspond to an existing element/flow in runtime/control-plane.html; every documented command/flag must exist in runtime/atl-manager.mjs CLI help.
Any new or restructured docs page must be added to the doc_set in docs/sync.yml or the next docs sync will not diff it.
No runtime code changes: this plan touches the skill file, docs site, diagrams/visuals, and package docs only.
README.fa.md (Persian) must be updated in parallel or explicitly marked as pending translation; it may not silently drift.
Visuals and interactive example spaces must use sanitized, representative data only — no real project data (precedent: docs/diagrams/atl-web-control-plane-preview.svg rule in docs/README.md).
The skill file lives outside this repository; its edit cannot be verified by repo checks, so it needs an explicit local self-check step and a pointer from the repo docs conventions.
risks: Format drift into design plagiarism if mishka.tools pages are imitated visually rather than structurally; mitigated by capturing an abstract page template in the research notes before touching any ATL page.
Docs overclaiming: mishka-style 'live example' blocks could imply behaviors the Web Control Plane does not yet ship; mitigated by the runtime-mapping evidence gate per step.
Silent sync gap: pages not listed in docs/sync.yml doc_set bypass the established docs-check boundary and can ship unverified.
The SKILL.md edit is outside git, so regressions there are invisible to CI; mitigated by a required checklist section in the skill plus a repo-side convention reference.
Scope creep back into TUI documentation or TUI fixes, contradicting the stated intent; mitigated by grep guards against TUI-primary phrasing.
Interactive demo 'spaces' embedded in docs could leak real feed/queue data if built from live state; mitigated by requiring hand-authored sanitized fixtures.
Bilingual README drift: updating README.md/USAGE.md without README.fa.md leaves the Persian package docs contradicted.
completion_checks: atl-tech-docs SKILL.md contains a prescribed mishka-style page template (brief, preview/visual, examples, usage/commands, edge cases, related links) plus ATL evidence rules and an explicit web-only scope statement excluding the terminal TUI from primary docs.

A format research note exists recording the section inventory observed on the six mishka.tools/chelekom reference pages (docs, sidebar, carousel, design-system, ai, cli) with one structural pattern captured per section.

docs/control-room.html is restructured into per-feature sections (browser spaces, compose, review, queue, preview, confirm, safe stop) each with brief, visual, and step-by-step interaction example, all mapping to runtime/control-plane.html.
A CLI reference page in the mishka /docs/cli style documents shipped commands with per-command examples, and every flag matches runtime/atl-manager.mjs help output.
Every new/edited page and visual asset is listed in docs/sync.yml doc_set.
All internal links and referenced diagram/asset paths in changed pages resolve to existing files.
README.md, USAGE.md, GUIDE.md, and README.fa.md reflect the web+CLI scope with visuals and contain no TUI-primary guidance.
All diagram/SVG assets added or edited are sanitized representative art with no real project data.

acceptance_examples.then: they find a concrete mishka-style page template (brief, preview, examples, usage/commands, edge notes, related links) with ATL evidence rules and the web-only scope statement, so two writers produce structurally identical pages

acceptance_examples.when: a reader wants to learn one Web Control Plane interaction such as compose to review to queue to confirm
acceptance_examples.then: the page presents a short brief, an embedded sanitized visual or preview space, and a numbered interaction walkthrough, with no TUI alternative offered as the primary path

acceptance_examples.given: a command documented on the new CLI reference page
acceptance_examples.when: it is compared against the CLI help output in runtime/atl-manager.mjs
acceptance_examples.then: every documented command, flag, and example exists in the shipped CLI with matching semantics, and no removed or renamed command remains documented

acceptance_examples.given: a new consumer installing @depie99/atl from npm
acceptance_examples.then: they reach a working Web Control Plane session and a first CLI command within the quickstart, guided by at least one visual, with the terminal TUI mentioned only as a compatibility surface

acceptance_examples.given: the docs sync boundary in docs/sync.yml
acceptance_examples.when: the set of changed and newly created pages and assets is diffed against doc_set
acceptance_examples.then: every changed page and every new asset path appears in doc_set with no untracked docs output remaining outside it

acceptance_examples.given: any HTML page or README changed by this plan
acceptance_examples.when: it is searched for TUI-primary phrasing such as TUI enhancements, improved TUI, or TUI-first instructions
acceptance_examples.then: no such phrasing is found; TUI mentions are limited to compatibility-surface notes

verifier_commands: git diff --stat docs/ README.md USAGE.md GUIDE.md README.fa.md .agents/skills/atl-tech-docs/SKILL.md
grep -rniE "tui[^\.]*(enhanc|improv|fix)|improved tui|tui-first|in the tui" docs/*.html README.md USAGE.md GUIDE.md README.fa.md || echo GUARD-OK
for f in $(grep -ohE "diagrams/[a-z0-9._-]+" docs/*.html README.md USAGE.md | sort -u); do test -f "docs/$f" || echo "MISSING docs/$f"; done
git diff --name-only docs/ | while read f; do grep -qF "$f" docs/sync.yml || echo "NOT-IN-DOC_SET: $f"; done
grep -q "Web Control Plane" C:/Users/Sanaz/.agents/skills/atl-tech-docs/SKILL.md && grep -qi "tui" C:/Users/Sanaz/.agents/skills/atl-tech-docs/SKILL.md && echo SKILL-SCOPE-PRESENT
